camel_example: aliyun live AddCasterVideoResource --region cn-hangzhou --BeginOffset 1000 --MaterialId f080575eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --ResourceName test001 --LocationId RV01 --RepeatNum 0 --ImageUrl 'http://learn.aliyundoc.com/AppName/image.jpg' --LiveStreamUrl 'rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/caster/4a82a3d1b7f0462ea3734836620100000auth_key=1608953344-0-0-ac8c628078541d7055a170ec59a50000' --PtsCallbackInterval 2000 --FixedDelayDuration 0 --VodUrl 'http://learn.aliyundoc.com/AppName/StreamName.flv' --EndOffset 10000 --ImageId a089175eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --CasterId 'LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000'
description_en: Adds a video source to a production studio. The number of video sources that you can add is limited by the number of ingest endpoints in the production studio
description_zh: 添加视频源，视频源数量受限于导播台输入路数
kebab_example: aliyun live add-caster-video-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --resource-name test001 --location-id RV01 --live-stream-url rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/caster/4a82a3d1b7f0462ea3734836620100000auth_key=1608953344-0-0-ac8c628078541d7055a170ec59a50000 --material-id f080575eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --vod-url http://learn.aliyundoc.com/AppName/StreamName.flv --begin-offset 1000 --end-offset 10000 --repeat-num 0 --pts-callback-interval 2000 --fixed-delay-duration 0 --image-id a089175eb5f4427684fc0715159a0000 --image-url http://learn.aliyundoc.com/AppName/image.jpg --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCasterVideoResource

parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**路径查看导播台名称。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, find the CasterId value in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to **Live Console** > **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** to find the name of the production studio.

> The name of a production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID
parameters.name: resource_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the video source
parameters.help_zh:
用于标识视频源位置。本参数必填。 

定义布局内画面的引用编号，每个位置至多关联一个资源，格式需符合“RV01~RV12”，即RV+数字，数字范围`[01~99]`
parameters.name: location_id

parameters.help_en:
The location identifier for the video source. This parameter is required.

The identifier references the video's position in the layout. Each location supports a maximum of one resource. The format is RV followed by a number from 01 to 99. For example, `RV01`
parameters.help_zh:
阿里云直播流地址。

><notice> 
 
-  当视频源类型为直播流时，本参数必填。
 
-  视频源类型不是直播流时，请求时不要带这个参数。

></notice>
parameters.name: live_stream_url

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud streaming URL.

><notice>

- This parameter is required if the video source type is live stream.

- If the video source type is not live stream, do not include this parameter in the request.

></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
媒资库素材ID。
><notice>当视频源类型为素材时，本参数才可用且必须传入。
></notice>

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848011.html查询导播台配置信息，请查看DescribeCasterConfig接口调用返回的参数UrgentMaterialId值。

> UrgentMaterialId值即为媒资库素材ID值
parameters.name: material_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the media asset.
><notice>This parameter is required and takes effect only when the video source is a media asset.></notice>

If you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848011.html operation to query the configuration of the production studio, view the value of the UrgentMaterialId parameter in the response.

> The value of UrgentMaterialId is the ID of the media asset
parameters.help_zh:
点播文件地址。
><notice>当视频源类型为文件视频且视频文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。
></notice>

>点播文件仅限MP4、FLV、TS格式
parameters.name: vod_url

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the video-on-demand (VOD) file.
><notice>This parameter is active only when the video source is a file that is not in the Material Library.></notice>

> The VOD file must be in MP4, FLV, or TS format
parameters.help_zh:
视频文件起始偏移值。单位：毫秒。
><notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
></notice>

> 大于**0**，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间作为开始读取的位置
parameters.name: begin_offset

parameters.help_en:
The start offset of the video file, in milliseconds.
><notice>This parameter is valid only when the video source is a file.></notice>

> A value greater than **0** specifies the offset from the first frame. The system starts to read the file from this offset
parameters.help_zh:
视频文件结束偏移值。单位：毫秒。
><notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
></notice>
        
- 大于**0**时：从相对于首帧的偏差时间为结束读取的位置。
- 小于**0**时：相对于最后一帧的偏差时间作为结束读取的位置。
parameters.name: end_offset

parameters.help_en:
The end offset value for the video file. Unit: ms.
><notice>This parameter is valid only when the video source is a file.></notice>

- A value greater than **0** sets the end point for reading at an offset from the first frame.

- A value less than **0** sets the end point for reading at an offset from the last frame
parameters.help_zh:
播放完后重复继续播放的次数。取值：
><notice>当视频源类型为文件视频时，本参数才有用。
></notice>

- **0**（默认值）：不重复播放。
- **-1**：一直循环重复
parameters.name: repeat_num

parameters.help_en:
The number of times to repeat the video.
><notice>This parameter is valid only when the video source is a file.></notice>

- **0** (default): The video plays only once.

- **-1**: The video repeats indefinitely
parameters.name: pts_callback_interval

parameters.help_en: The PTS callback interval. The unit is milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 该字段对视频进行固定延迟设置，可用于字幕同步。单位ms, 默认取值为0， 取值范围`[0-5000]`
parameters.name: fixed_delay_duration

parameters.help_en: This field sets a fixed delay for the video to synchronize captions. The unit is ms. The default value is 0. The value range is `[0-5000]`
parameters.help_zh:
媒资库图片素材ID。
> 当视频源类型为图片时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the image asset.

> This parameter is active and required only when the video source type is Image
parameters.help_zh:
图片素材URL。
>当视频源类型为图片且图片文件未导入素材库时，本参数才可用。支持上传jpg、png格式图片，最大文件不可超过10M
